title: A redirect from `https` to `http` needs `net.downgrade` for its host and `redirectToHttp` at the call; a plain `http` URL asked for directly stays allowed
divergesFromPhp: curl follows a hop from `https` to `http` silently, so one `Location` header strips a call's TLS; here it needs a grant and a call-site option, and the refusal names the grant
